concerns.text: FR-005 requires a multivariate logistic regression model (with IPW) to predict discontinuity type, but no task in the document implements this analysis step.
FR-019 / SC-012 mandates generation of a `runtime_pilot_report.md` artifact documenting the pre‑flight runtime pilot, yet no task creates this report.

SC-006 expects a dedicated `divergence_scores.csv` file containing raw divergence scores; the current tasks only produce `divergence_features.csv` which bundles additional columns and does not satisfy the required artifact.
FR-018 / SC-011 require a `synthetic_validation_report.md` summarizing validation of the synthetic subset, but no task is defined to generate this report.

SC-001 specifies that Pearson and Spearman correlation results (including p‑value) must be recorded in a clearly defined format; the existing task T022 outputs `correlation_results.json` without guaranteeing the required format, leaving a potential gap in testability.
